mod.name: VCMI extras
mod.description:
Collection of enhancements and fixes for VCMI interface and gameplay:

• Extended lobby options
 Adds template selection, map size buttons (H / XH / G / C), chess timer, and support for simultaneous turns

• Revisit & Search buttons
 Adds buttons to revisit the current object and perform contextual searches on the adventure map

• Quick Exchange
 Improves the hero exchange screen with one-click swap buttons for all creatures and artifacts

• Vertical layout (portrait mode)
 Optimizes the adventure map interface for vertical screen orientation (portrait mode)

• Bonus icons
 Adds visual indicators for unit bonuses and special abilities

• Spell immunity icons
 Displays spell immunity icons for creatures during combat

• Emoji support
 Enables emoji font rendering in the in-game chat
mod.adventuremap.name: Revisit and Search Buttons
mod.adventuremap.description:
Adds two new buttons to the adventure map interface:

• Revisit – allows re-entering the currently occupied object
• Search – allows finding objects within the explored area of the map

Also includes a custom hero icon.
mod.arrowtowericons.name: Arrow Tower Icons
mod.arrowtowericons.description: Adds proper initiative bar icons for arrow towers during castle siege battles.
mod.bonusicons.name: Bonus Icons
mod.bonusicons.description:
Collection of graphical improvements for unit status in combat:

• Bonus and Ability Icons – adds icons for unit bonuses and abilities
• Spell Immunity Icons – shows visual indicators of spell immunity or resistance
mod.bonusicons.bonus icons.name: Bonus and Ability Icons
mod.bonusicons.bonus icons.description: Adds new graphical icons for various unit bonuses and abilities, enhancing visual feedback in battles and creature screens.
mod.bonusicons.immunity icons.name: Spell Immunity Bonus Icons
mod.bonusicons.immunity icons.descriptio: Adds icons to indicate spell immunity or resistance on units, improving clarity during battles.
mod.chroniclesicon.name: Chronicles icons
mod.emoji.name: Emoji Support
mod.emoji.description: Adds support for displaying emojis in in-game chat by using an emoji-compatible font.
mod.extendedlobby.name: Extended lobby options
mod.extendedlobby.description:
Improves the game lobby with advanced RMG configuration:

• Template selection
• Chess timer
• Map size buttons for H / XH / G / C
• Support for simultaneous turns
mod.quick-exchange.name: Quick Exchange
mod.quick-exchange.description:
This mod improves the heroes exchange window by adding new buttons to make swapping easier.

Adds:

• Swap all creatures button
• Swap all artifacts button
• Individual swap buttons for each creature
